title: The Number of Weak Characters in the Game
summary: Given a 2D integer array representing characters' attack and defense values, count how many characters are weaker than at least one other character, where a character is considered weaker if another character has both higher attack and defense values.
statement: Given a 2D integer array representing characters' attack and defense values, count how many characters are weaker than at least one other character, where a character is considered weaker if another character has both higher attack and defense values.
constraints: A character is weak only if another character has both strictly greater attack and strictly greater defense.
Return the number of weak characters.
hints: Equal attacks must never dominate each other.
Sort attack descending and defense ascending within equal attacks, then track the greatest defense already seen.
Earlier attack groups are strictly stronger; ascending equal groups cannot contribute a larger earlier defense, enforcing both strict inequalities.
editorial: Earlier attack groups are strictly stronger; ascending equal groups cannot contribute a larger earlier defense, enforcing both strict inequalities.

tests.explanation: No character is strictly dominated in both attributes.
The character two,two is dominated by three,three, so one is weak.
